about: How the Park draws each breed, keyed by breed id. size by typical adult weight (XS under ~5 kg, S ~5-10, M ~10-25, L ~25-40, XL over ~40); build: standard, long_low, tall_lean or stocky; snout 1 (flat) to 5 (very long); ears; tail; coat: smooth, wiry, feathered, long, fluffy, curly, corded or hairless; colour and markings: the breed's most typical colourway, matching its app photo where that's typical (parti and spotted are white dogs with patches or spots of the colour; saddle is a tan dog with a saddle of the colour); mask: a dark face mask.
